Hello!

Me and my partner have just gotten our first correspondence from the misrad hapnim. I am currently a student and they wrote that I have two files open at once and I would need to choose the shared life process or student visa. I don't really understand what this means, as I read it is allowed to apply for the shared life track on a student visa and keep the status. If not, how do I 'give up' my student visa? Do I just go to the interior ministry and ask? Would I be eligible for a tourist visa? Does this too mean I wouldn't be able to leave the country for the duration of the process? 

Any advice is appreciated and thank you!
